name: Recover a committed browser effect after restart
prompt: Use the supplied service-recovery portal in the browser. The complete workflow is to append the note 'Verified original request' to ticket SYN-17 exactly once, then set its status to Resolved exactly once. For this first phase, append and verify the note, then pause and report the saved state; do not change the status until my next message. Preserve the existing notes and every other record. If execution is interrupted or a result is uncertain, inspect the actual saved state before repeating any operation.
turns: The application was interrupted and restarted. Continue my original ticket workflow. Inspect the actual saved portal state first and complete only what remains; do not repeat a note or status change that already committed.
